title: Qantas Clears Out the Fleet, KLM's Billion-Euro Pain, and Delta's Windowless Window Seats
summary: Qantas is saying goodbye to the A380 early and offloading 44 Boeing 737s as it bets big on new jets — we break down what that means. Plus, KLM announces a painful billion-euro overhaul, Delta has to face a lawsuit over "window seats" with no actual window, Priceline's hotel partner gets hit with a billion-dollar fine, and we find out which United economy seats you'll probably never get to sit in.
